speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to begin my assessment, what is your gestational age and how many days old are you now?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

Thank you. Given your premature birth and mother's gestational diabetes, you are at high risk for RDS and Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn. I need to see your chest X-ray and arterial blood gas results to confirm the specific type of respiratory distress. REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas; REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
